recipe_name: Sel Roti with Aloo Chana Tarkari
nepali_name: सेलरोटी र आलु चना तरकारी
serving_description: 2 Sel Rotis + 1 bowl Aloo Chana curry
ingredients_display: Sel Roti (120g), Chana (80g), Alu (100g), Vanaspati Tel (8g)
recipe_steps: 1. Soak chana overnight and boil with cubed potatoes. 2. Sauté with cumin, turmeric, ginger-garlic, and tomato gravy. 3. Serve hot with 2 crispy traditional Sel Rotis.

recipe_name: Makai ko Roti with Boiled Egg & Tea
nepali_name: मसिना मकैको रोटी, उसिनेको अण्डा र चिया
serving_description: 2 Makai Rotis + 1 Boiled Egg + 1 cup Milk Tea
ingredients_display: Seto Makaiko Pitho (100g), Kukhurako Ful (50g), Gaiko Dudh (150g)
recipe_steps: 1. Knead yellow maize flour with warm water. 2. Flatten and roast maize rotis on tawa. 3. Boil 1 hen egg for 8-10 mins. 4. Serve with hot Nepali milk tea.

recipe_name: Chiura with Fresh Dahi & Roasted Bhatmas
nepali_name: चिउरा, दही र भुटेको कालो भटमास
serving_description: 1 bowl Cheura + 1 cup Dahi + 1 handful roasted black soybean
ingredients_display: Cheura (80g), Dahi (150g), Bhatamas Kalo (30g)
recipe_steps: 1. Measure beaten rice (cheura) into a bowl. 2. Pour fresh curd (dahi) on top. 3. Top with crunchy dry-roasted black soybeans (bhatmas) for high-protein breakfast.

recipe_name: Sarvottam Pitho Lito with Milk & Honey
nepali_name: सर्वोत्तम पीठोको पोषिलो लिटो
serving_description: 1 warm bowl roasted multigrain Lito porridge
ingredients_display: Lito (70g), Gaiko Dudh (200g), Maha (15g)
recipe_steps: 1. Whisk roasted multigrain flour (Sarvottam Pitho) in warm milk. 2. Simmer on low heat for 5 minutes until thick. 3. Sweeten with raw honey.

recipe_name: Phapar ko Roti with Chhurpi Tomato Achaar
nepali_name: फापरको रोटी र छुर्पी-गोलभेडाको अचार
serving_description: 2 Buckwheat Flatbreads + 1 small bowl Chhurpi Achaar + Tea
ingredients_display: Phaparko Pitho (100g), Cheese (40g), Golveda Pakeko (80g), Hariyo Khursani (5g)
recipe_steps: 1. Make smooth buckwheat (phapar) batter. 2. Pour onto griddle and cook like a crepe. 3. Grind roasted tomatoes, chillies, and local Chhurpi into a zesty dipping achaar.

recipe_name: Sprouted Mung Salad with Boiled Egg
nepali_name: टुसा उमारेको मुङ सलाद र अण्डा
serving_description: 1 large bowl sprouted mung bean salad + 1 egg
ingredients_display: Mung ko Geda (80g), Kukhurako Ful (50g), Kankro (60g), Golveda Pakeko (60g)
recipe_steps: 1. Toss fresh sprouted mung beans with diced cucumber, tomatoes, green chilli, and lemon juice. 2. Top with a sliced boiled egg for high-protein morning nourishment.

recipe_name: Atta Chapati with Chana Tarkari
nepali_name: तातो गहुँको रोटी र चनाको तरकारी
serving_description: 2 Whole Wheat Rotis + 1 bowl dry spiced Chana
ingredients_display: Atta (Ganhuko Pitho) (80g), Chana (90g), Golveda Pakeko (60g), Vanaspati Tel (6g)
recipe_steps: 1. Roll and roast whole-wheat chapatis on tawa. 2. Sauté boiled chickpeas with ginger, garlic, onions, and tomatoes. 3. High-fiber balanced breakfast.

recipe_name: Oatmeal Porridge with Banana & Walnuts
nepali_name: जईको जाउलो, पाकेको केरा र ओखर
serving_description: 1 bowl warm oats cooked in milk with fruit and nuts
ingredients_display: Jaiko Chaikla (60g), Gaiko Dudh (200g), Kera Pakeko (80g), Okhar (20g)
recipe_steps: 1. Cook oats in milk for 4-5 minutes until creamy. 2. Slice 1 ripe banana on top. 3. Garnish with chopped Himalayan walnut halves for healthy Omega-3 fats.

recipe_name: Makai Bhatmas Khaja with Black Tea
nepali_name: भुटेको मकै-भटमास खाजा र कालो चिया
serving_description: 1 bowl dry roasted mountain corn and soybeans + black tea
ingredients_display: Makai Sukeko (60g), Bhatamas Kalo (40g)
recipe_steps: 1. Dry roast mountain maize and black soybeans in iron pan until popped and fragrant. 2. Enjoy with Himalayan black tea as an energizing traditional breakfast.

recipe_name: Bara (Wo) with Egg & Tomato Sesame Chutney
nepali_name: अण्डा बारा र गोलभेडा-तीलको अचार
serving_description: 2 Newari Black Lentil Patties topped with Egg + Achaar
ingredients_display: Masko Dal (80g), Kukhurako Ful (50g), Golveda Pakeko (60g), Kalo Til Dana (10g), Tori Tel (8g)
recipe_steps: 1. Grind soaked black lentils (maas) into thick batter with ginger and garlic. 2. Pan-fry patty on tawa, crack an egg on top and flip. 3. Serve with roasted sesame-tomato chutney.

recipe_name: Chatamari with Minced Buff & Coriander
nepali_name: नेवारी चटामरी (राँगाको किमा सहित)
serving_description: 2 Rice Crepes topped with spiced minced buffalo meat
ingredients_display: Chamal (Millma Kuteko) (90g), Ranga ko Masu (60g), Pyaja Thulo (30g), Hariyo Dhaniyako Pat (10g), Vanaspati Tel (6g)
recipe_steps: 1. Make thin rice flour batter. 2. Spread thinly on heated covered pan. 3. Top with seasoned minced buff meat, onions, cilantro, and steam until base is crisp.

recipe_name: Tsampa Porridge with Yak Cheese & Butter Tea
nepali_name: साम्पा जाउलो, छुर्पी र सुजीया चिया
serving_description: 1 bowl roasted barley flour porridge with butter & cheese
ingredients_display: Jaun (70g), Cheese (30g), Makhhan (10g), Gaiko Dudh (150g)
recipe_steps: 1. Mix roasted barley flour (Tsampa) into warm churned butter tea or milk. 2. Stir in dried Himalayan chhurpi cubes. 3. High-calorie sustained energy for mountain mornings.

recipe_name: Kodo ko Babari (Pancake) with Dahi
nepali_name: कोदोको बाबरी र ताजा दही
serving_description: 2 Finger Millet savory pancakes with fresh curd
ingredients_display: Kodo (80g), Dahi (120g), Vanaspati Tel (6g)
recipe_steps: 1. Whisk finger millet (kodo) flour with water, salt, and ajwain. 2. Pan fry into soft thin babari pancakes. 3. Pair with fresh local cow curd (dahi).

recipe_name: Dahi Chura with Mango & Jaggery
nepali_name: मिथिला दही-चिउरा, आँप र सख्खर
serving_description: 1 bowl Mithila beaten rice with curd, ripe mango & gur
ingredients_display: Cheura (90g), Dahi (150g), Anpa Pakeko (80g), Sakkhar (15g)
recipe_steps: 1. Combine beaten rice (cheura) with rich creamy curd. 2. Top with sweet ripe Terai mango slices and pure crushed jaggery (gur). 3. Traditional refreshing Terai breakfast.

recipe_name: Aloo Paratha with Mint Coriander Chutney
nepali_name: आलु पराठा र पुदिना-धनियाको अचार
serving_description: 2 whole wheat flatbreads stuffed with spiced mashed potato
ingredients_display: Atta (Ganhuko Pitho) (80g), Alu (90g), Pudinako Pat (15g), Hariyo Dhaniyako Pat (15g), Gaiko Ghyu (8g)
recipe_steps: 1. Mash boiled potatoes with cumin, turmeric, green chillies, and coriander. 2. Stuff inside whole-wheat dough and roll into paratha. 3. Roast with ghee and serve with fresh mint chutney.

recipe_name: Suji ko Halwa with Milk & Almonds
nepali_name: घ्यूमा भुटेको सुजीको हलुवा र बदाम
serving_description: 1 bowl semolina halwa cooked in ghee with warm milk and nuts
ingredients_display: Suji (60g), Gaiko Ghyu (10g), Gaiko Dudh (150g), Madeshe Badam (15g), Chini (15g)
recipe_steps: 1. Roast semolina (suji) in pure cow ghee until golden brown. 2. Add boiling milk and sugar, stirring continuously until smooth. 3. Garnish with sliced almonds.

recipe_name: Boiled Sweet Potato & Cow Milk Breakfast
nepali_name: उसिनेको सखरखण्ड र तातो गाईको दूध
serving_description: 2 steamed sweet potatoes + 1 glass hot cow milk
ingredients_display: Sakharkhanda Rato (160g), Gaiko Dudh (200g)
recipe_steps: 1. Steam sweet potatoes until fork tender. 2. Peel and serve with a warm glass of boiled farm-fresh cow milk. 3. Naturally sweet, high-potassium, low-GI breakfast.

recipe_name: Bhuja Mix Tarkari (Puffed Rice Breakfast)
nepali_name: भुजा मोथेको खाजा (चना र तरकारी सहित)
serving_description: 1 bowl puffed rice tossed with boiled chana, onion, tomato & mustard oil
ingredients_display: Golfuki / Bhuja (50g), Chana (50g), Pyaja Thulo (30g), Golveda Pakeko (40g), Tori Tel (6g)
recipe_steps: 1. Toss crispy puffed rice (bhuja/murhi) with boiled chickpeas, diced onion, tomatoes, and green chillies. 2. Drizzle raw mustard oil and lemon juice for classic Terai morning snack.

recipe_name: Fapar ko Dosa with Coconut Sesame Chutney
nepali_name: फापरको डोसा र नरिवल-तीलको अचार
serving_description: 2 crispy buckwheat crepes with fresh chutney
ingredients_display: Phaparko Pitho (80g), Nariwal Taja (25g), Seto Til Dana (10g), Hariyo Khursani (5g), Vanaspati Tel (6g)
recipe_steps: 1. Make light runny batter of buckwheat flour and cumin. 2. Spread thinly on hot cast-iron tawa until golden and crisp. 3. Serve with fresh ground coconut-sesame chutney.

recipe_name: Poha (Cheura Bhuteko) with Green Peas & Peanuts
nepali_name: हरियो केराउ र बदाम सहित भुटेको चिउरा
serving_description: 1 plate spiced sautéed beaten rice with peas and roasted peanuts
ingredients_display: Cheura (70g), Hariyo Kerau (40g), Badam Bhuteko (20g), Pyaja Thulo (30g), Vanaspati Tel (8g)
recipe_steps: 1. Rinse beaten rice and drain. 2. Sauté cumin, mustard seeds, onions, fresh green peas, and crunchy peanuts in oil with turmeric. 3. Toss poha and steam for 3 mins.

recipe_name: Litti with Chana Ghugni (Mithila Breakfast)
nepali_name: सत्तू भरिएको लिट्टी र चना घुघनी
serving_description: 2 roasted whole wheat sattu balls + 1 bowl spiced black chana
ingredients_display: Atta (Ganhuko Pitho) (80g), Besan (40g), Chana (60g), Tori Tel (8g)
recipe_steps: 1. Stuff whole wheat dough with seasoned roasted gram flour (sattu), ajwain, and mustard oil. 2. Bake or grill littis over coals. 3. Serve with hearty black gram chana ghugni.

recipe_name: Cornflakes with Warm Milk & Papaya Slices
nepali_name: मकैको चोकर (कर्नफ्लेक्स), दूध र मेवा
serving_description: 1 bowl cornflakes in milk + 1 bowl cubed fresh papaya
ingredients_display: Makaiko Chaikla (50g), Gaiko Dudh (200g), Mewa Pakeko (100g)
recipe_steps: 1. Add crispy cornflakes to a bowl of warm milk. 2. Pair with a bowl of fresh sweet papaya cubes for natural digestive enzymes.

recipe_name: Mung Dal Chilla with Mint Chutney
nepali_name: मुङको दालको चिल्ला र हरियो अचार
serving_description: 2 savory yellow lentil pancakes with mint sauce
ingredients_display: Mungako Dal Pahelo (80g), Pudinako Pat (15g), Golveda Pakeko (40g), Vanaspati Tel (6g)
recipe_steps: 1. Grind soaked yellow mung dal into a smooth batter with ginger and green chillies. 2. Spread onto a hot pan and cook with minimal oil. 3. High protein vegan breakfast.

recipe_name: Riki Kur (Sherpa Potato Pancake) with Dahi
nepali_name: रिकी कुर (आलुको परम्परागत प्यानकेक)
serving_description: 2 grated mountain potato pancakes with local curd
ingredients_display: Alu (140g), Atta (Ganhuko Pitho) (30g), Dahi (100g), Gaiko Ghyu (6g)
recipe_steps: 1. Grate raw mountain potatoes finely and mix with pinch of flour and salt. 2. Pan fry into thick golden potato pancakes. 3. Serve with fresh mountain yak/cow dahi.

recipe_name: Brown Bread with Scrambled Egg & Tomato
nepali_name: खैरो पाउरोटी, अण्डा भुर्जी र गोलभेडा
serving_description: 2 slices whole wheat toast + 2 scrambled eggs with onion & tomato
ingredients_display: Pauroti Khairo (70g), Kukhurako Ful (100g), Pyaja Thulo (30g), Golveda Pakeko (40g), Vanaspati Tel (6g)
recipe_steps: 1. Toast brown bread slices. 2. Whisk 2 eggs and scramble in pan with chopped onions, tomatoes, and mild pepper. 3. Serve warm.

recipe_name: Besan Puda with Dahi & Coriander
nepali_name: बेसनको पुडा र ताजा दही
serving_description: 2 savory chickpea flour crepes with dahi
ingredients_display: Besan (70g), Dahi (120g), Hariyo Dhaniyako Pat (10g), Vanaspati Tel (6g)
recipe_steps: 1. Whisk gram flour (besan) with water, turmeric, ajwain, and chopped coriander. 2. Pour onto griddle and cook on both sides until golden. 3. Serve with chilled dahi.

recipe_name: Chamre Rice with Boiled Egg & Timur Achaar
nepali_name: चम्रे भात, उसिनेको अण्डा र टिमुर अचार
serving_description: 1 bowl turmeric-ghee tempered Chamre rice + 1 egg + achaar
ingredients_display: Chamal (Millma Kuteko) (80g), Gaiko Ghyu (6g), Kukhurako Ful (50g), Golveda Pakeko (50g)
recipe_steps: 1. Sauté rice with turmeric, cumin, and a touch of ghee (Chamre bhat). 2. Top with a sliced boiled egg and a dollop of zesty roasted timur-tomato dip.

recipe_name: Paneer Stuffed Whole Wheat Paratha
nepali_name: पनिर भरिएको तातो पराठा र दही
serving_description: 2 whole wheat flatbreads stuffed with spiced fresh paneer
ingredients_display: Atta (Ganhuko Pitho) (80g), Paneer (60g), Dahi (100g), Gaiko Ghyu (6g)
recipe_steps: 1. Crumble fresh paneer with ginger, cilantro, and garam masala. 2. Stuff inside whole-wheat dough and roll out. 3. Roast on tawa with a light brush of ghee and serve with dahi.

recipe_name: Kaguno (Foxtail Millet) Porridge with Milk
nepali_name: कागुनोको खिर/जाउलो र तातो दूध
serving_description: 1 bowl sweet foxtail millet porridge with cardamom and milk
ingredients_display: Kaguno (60g), Gaiko Dudh (200g), Madeshe Badam (10g), Sakkhar (15g)
recipe_steps: 1. Simmer ancient foxtail millet (kaguno) in milk with crushed cardamom until soft and creamy. 2. Sweeten with organic gur/jaggery and top with sliced almonds.

recipe_name: Gundruk Sandheko with Beaten Rice
nepali_name: गुन्द्रुक साँधेको र चिउरा खाजा
serving_description: 1 bowl spicy marinated sun-dried gundruk with crispy cheura
ingredients_display: Toriko Gundruk (30g), Cheura (70g), Pyaja Thulo (20g), Tori Tel (6g)
recipe_steps: 1. Roast dry gundruk lightly and crush by hand. 2. Toss with chopped onion, green chilli, roasted mustard oil, and lemon. 3. Eat with crisp beaten rice.

recipe_name: Steamed Veg Momo Set (Breakfast Portion)
nepali_name: तातो भेज मःम र सुप
serving_description: 6 pieces steamed vegetable dumplings with soup
ingredients_display: Veg Momo (120g), Golveda Pakeko (50g), Hariyo Dhaniyako Pat (10g)
recipe_steps: 1. Steam fresh vegetable momos for 10 minutes. 2. Serve with spicy roasted tomato-sesame achaar and warm clear soup.

recipe_name: Steamed Chicken Momo Set (Breakfast Portion)
nepali_name: कुखुराको तातो मःम र झोल
serving_description: 6 pieces steamed chicken dumplings with jhol soup
ingredients_display: Chicken Momo (120g), Golveda Pakeko (50g), Aduwa Haledo (5g)
recipe_steps: 1. Steam spiced minced chicken dumplings. 2. Serve with warm aromatic sesame-tomato broth.

recipe_name: Steamed Buff Momo Set (Breakfast Portion)
nepali_name: राँगाको तातो मःम र अचार
serving_description: 6 pieces steamed buffalo meat dumplings with achaar
ingredients_display: Buff Momo (120g), Golveda Pakeko (50g), Hariyo Khursani (5g)
recipe_steps: 1. Steam fresh buff momos for 10 minutes until juicy. 2. Serve with classic spicy timur-tomato dip.

recipe_name: Chicken Chowmein (Nepali Street Style)
nepali_name: कुखुराको चाउमिन (नेपाली शैली)
serving_description: Wok-tossed egg noodles with shredded chicken & vegetables
ingredients_display: Sewai (70g), Kukhura ko Masu (70g), Bandakobi (40g), Ganjar (30g), Vanaspati Tel (8g)
recipe_steps: 1. Boil noodles al dente. 2. Wok-toss sliced chicken with garlic, cabbage, carrots, onion, soy sauce, and pepper. 3. Combine with noodles.

recipe_name: Veg Chowmein with Tofu & Cabbage
nepali_name: भेज चाउमिन (टोफु र तरकारी सहित)
serving_description: Stir-fried noodles with pan-seared tofu & fresh vegetables
ingredients_display: Sewai (70g), Tofu (60g), Bandakobi (50g), Ganjar (30g), Vanaspati Tel (8g)
recipe_steps: 1. Stir-fry tofu cubes with julienned vegetables in hot wok. 2. Toss boiled noodles with soy sauce, vinegar, and green chillies.

recipe_name: Egg Chowmein with Spring Onion
nepali_name: अण्डा चाउमिन र हरियो प्याज
serving_description: Stir-fried noodles with scrambled egg, onions & veggies
ingredients_display: Sewai (70g), Kukhurako Ful (50g), Bandakobi (40g), Pyaja Thulo (30g), Vanaspati Tel (8g)
recipe_steps: 1. Scramble egg in wok. 2. Add cabbage, carrots, and boiled noodles with mild seasoning. 3. Garnish with chopped spring onion.

recipe_name: Samay Baji Breakfast Khaja Set
nepali_name: नेवारी समय बजी खाजा सेट
serving_description: Traditional Newari platter: Cheura, Black Soybeans, Saag & Aloo Achaar
ingredients_display: Cheura (70g), Bhatamas Kalo (30g), Rayoko Sag (50g), Alu (60g), Tori Tel (6g)
recipe_steps: 1. Arrange crisp beaten rice (cheura). 2. Add roasted black soybean (bhatmas), sautéed mustard greens, and boiled spiced potato pickle.

recipe_name: Samosa Tarkari Breakfast Set
nepali_name: तातो समोसा र चनाको तरकारी
serving_description: 1 crispy potato Samosa + 1 bowl spiced chana curry
ingredients_display: Samosa (80g), Chana (60g), Golveda Pakeko (40g), Vanaspati Tel (6g)
recipe_steps: 1. Re-crisp authentic Nepali samosa. 2. Ladle hot spiced chickpea (chana) curry over it with tamarind and green chutney.

recipe_name: Pakauda with Masala Milk Tea
nepali_name: तातो पकौडा र मसला चिया
serving_description: Crisp onion-gram flour fritters with fresh milk tea
ingredients_display: Pakauda (80g), Gaiko Dudh (150g), Chini (10g)
recipe_steps: 1. Fry seasoned gram flour vegetable fritters until golden and crisp. 2. Serve with hot boiled spiced cardamom milk tea.

recipe_name: Aaluchap with Beaten Rice (Chiura)
nepali_name: आलुचाप र भुटेको चिउरा
serving_description: Spiced potato croquette with crispy beaten rice
ingredients_display: Aaluchap (90g), Cheura (60g), Golveda Pakeko (40g)
recipe_steps: 1. Golden spiced mashed potato cutlet (aaluchap). 2. Serve with crunchy beaten rice and roasted tomato dip.

recipe_name: Classic Nepali Dal Bhat Tarkari Thali
nepali_name: नेपाली दाल भात र साग तरकारी थाली
serving_description: Standard 1 Thali plate: Rice + Lentil soup + Saag + Achaar
ingredients_display: Chamal (Millma Kuteko) (150g), Musuro (100g), Rayoko Sag (100g), Tori Tel (8g)
recipe_steps: 1. Steam rice in pressure cooker. 2. Boil musuro dal with turmeric and temper with garlic and mustard oil. 3. Sauté mustard greens (rayo saag) on medium heat.

recipe_name: Thakali Dal Bhat Set (Jimbu Black Dal)
nepali_name: थकाली दाल भात थाली (जिम्मुले झनेको कालो दाल)
serving_description: Thakali set: Rice + Black Dal with Jimbu + Gundruk + Aloo Tareko
ingredients_display: Chamal (Millma Kuteko) (150g), Masko Dal (90g), Toriko Gundruk (25g), Alu (70g), Gaiko Ghyu (8g)
recipe_steps: 1. Cook black gram dal in iron pot. 2. Temper with mountain herb Jimbu and pure ghee. 3. Serve with steamed rice, spiced potato fry, and gundruk achaar.

recipe_name: Chicken Curry Dal Bhat Thali
nepali_name: कुखुराको मासु, दाल भात र साग थाली
serving_description: 1 complete non-veg Thali: Rice + Lentils + Chicken curry + Greens
ingredients_display: Chamal (Millma Kuteko) (150g), Raharko Dal (80g), Kukhura ko Masu (90g), Rayoko Sag (100g), Tori Tel (8g)
recipe_steps: 1. Prepare yellow Rahar dal. 2. Sauté chicken with onions, garlic, ginger, and Nepali spices into rich gravy. 3. Serve with steamed rice and stir-fried greens.

recipe_name: Mutton Khasi Curry Dal Bhat Thali
nepali_name: खसीको मासु, कालो दाल र भात थाली
serving_description: 1 premium festive Thali: Rice + Black dal + Goat curry
ingredients_display: Chamal (Millma Kuteko) (150g), Masko Dal (80g), Khasi ko Masu (80g), Kauli (80g), Tori Tel (8g)
recipe_steps: 1. Slow cook black gram dal in karahi. 2. Pressure cook tender lean goat meat in traditional masala gravy. 3. Serve with steamed rice and seasonal cauliflower.

recipe_name: Rohu Fish Curry with Steamed Rice
nepali_name: रहु माछाको झोल, उसिनेको भात र सलाद
serving_description: 1 plate steamed parboiled rice with Terai Rohu fish jhol
ingredients_display: Usinako Chamal (Dhikima) (150g), Rahu Machha (100g), Golveda Pakeko (80g), Kankro (60g), Tori Tel (8g)
recipe_steps: 1. Sear fresh Rohu fish in mustard oil. 2. Simmer in tomato-fenugreek gravy. 3. Serve over parboiled rice with fresh cucumber slices.

recipe_name: Buff Curry Thali with Rice & Saag
nepali_name: राँगाको मासु, भात र रायोको साग थाली
serving_description: 1 Thali plate: Rice + Buff meat curry + Lentil + Greens
ingredients_display: Chamal (Millma Kuteko) (150g), Musuro (70g), Ranga ko Masu (90g), Rayoko Sag (100g), Tori Tel (8g)
recipe_steps: 1. Pressure cook lean buffalo meat with ginger-garlic paste and garam masala. 2. Pair with yellow lentil dal, steamed rice, and stir-fried rayo greens.

recipe_name: Pork Curry with Rice & Saag (Kirat Style)
nepali_name: सुँगुरको मासु, भात र रायोको साग थाली
serving_description: Traditional Eastern pork curry with steamed rice and leafy greens
ingredients_display: Chamal (Millma Kuteko) (150g), Sungurako Masu (80g), Rayoko Sag (100g), Musuro (60g), Tori Tel (6g)
recipe_steps: 1. Sauté lean pork with ginger, garlic, shallots, and green chillies. 2. Simmer until meat is tender. 3. Serve with hot steamed rice and mustard greens.

recipe_name: Kodo ko Dhindo with Gundruk Bhatmas & Ghyu
nepali_name: कोदोको ढिँडो, गुन्द्रुक-भटमास र घ्यू थाली
serving_description: 1 traditional bowl Kodo Dhindo + Gundruk soup + 1 tsp Ghee
ingredients_display: Kodo (140g), Toriko Gundruk (30g), Bhatamas Kalo (40g), Gaiko Ghyu (8g)
recipe_steps: 1. Vigorously stir finger millet flour in boiling water until smooth dhindo forms. 2. Simmer sun-dried gundruk with roasted bhatmas into tangy jhol. 3. Serve with pure cow ghee.

nepali_name: सुँगुरको सेकुवा र चिउरा (किराती परिकार)
